description: Real-time view of operational health measuring fulfillment volume, revenue efficiency, technician productivity, margin performance, and service disruption rates. Supports staffing, scheduling, cost control, and execution quality decisions.

Top-of-funnel view of demand generation performance tracking visibility, traffic, lead volume, and acquisition efficiency across paid and non-paid channels. Evaluates campaign reach, traffic quality, cost efficiency, channel mix, and lead acquisition performance.

Visibility into technician compensation, productivity, and payout drivers across the business. Tracks completed jobs, revenue produced, labor hours, commissions, and other compensation components to support payroll accuracy and consistency.

Centralized view of business performance across revenue, demand generation, conversion, and operations. Monitor core metrics, track trends over time, compare results against targets, and identify areas needing attention in a single self-serve interface.

Ranked view of technician performance across key productivity and quality metrics. Compare output, monitor revenue contribution, track utilization, and identify top performers as well as coaching opportunities.
Appointment capacity versus demand view supporting supply and demand planning. Monitor available slots, booked volume, utilization pressure, and capacity gaps across markets and time periods.

Centralized view of lead mix, lead quality, and demand signals across the funnel. Monitor lead sources, shifts in lead composition, customer intents, service categories, and match types to support marketing optimization and forecasting.

Visibility into gaps between expected and actual parts usage, pricing, billing, or reporting. Identify discrepancies impacting job profitability, inventory accuracy, technician execution, and customer billing.

Consolidated view of demand, available capacity, and operational balance across markets. Monitor booking demand vs technician supply, slot availability, utilization levels, and service capacity for faster staffing and scheduling decisions.

High-level view of GBL channel performance through overview and trends reporting. Monitor demand, bookings, cancellations, completions, revenue, and AOV to assess channel health and track growth, efficiency, and trend direction.

High-level view of partnership performance through overview and trends reporting. Monitor demand, bookings, and completions to assess partner health, track performance over time, and support growth and optimization decisions.

High-level view of referral performance tracking actuals versus targets, attainment, pacing, market rankings, and referral trends over time. Supports coaching, accountability, and faster decisions to improve referral growth and repair conversion.

Visibility into job cancellation trends, cancellation reasons, and controllable operational breakdowns across markets, technicians, and time periods. Monitors HQ-driven cancellations, customer-driven cancellations, reschedules, cancellation timing, and recurring reason patterns to help identify where execution issues or customer friction are affecting completed jobs and revenue.

dashboard_name: NuBrakes x Velocity Referral Program Dashboard
description: Visibility into referral performance generated through the Velocity partnership. Tracks referral volume, booked jobs, completed jobs, conversion performance, market rankings, store-level contribution, and estimated revenue impact to help leadership understand how partner-driven demand is performing across markets and locations. Supports partnership monitoring, coaching, accountability, and faster decisions around store engagement, referral growth, and downstream repair conversion.

Searchable photo asset library for organizing and reviewing NuBrakes technician photos and marketing-ready visuals. Helps the team quickly find usable images for campaign emails, Customer.io broadcasts, landing pages, social content, and other marketing materials.

Centralized view of local search visibility and review performance across markets and locations. Monitor keyword rankings, map pack presence, review volume, ratings, and review trends to identify opportunities to improve local discovery, customer trust, and GBL-driven demand.
